name: engineering-workflow
description: Codex engineering workflow with explicit repository setup, phase routing, bounded task-state and evidence tools, implementation, review, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Repository setup, task state, workflow routing, implementation, and delivery
interface.longDescription: A software engineering workflow plugin. It initializes repository-specific workflow conventions only on manual request, offers optional next-stage navigation through ask-matt, separates discovery from clarification, supports manual Wayfinder planning for large multi-module work across sessions, and provides a standard-library Harness CLI for task state, candidate Diff, diagnostic budgets, closeout, and safe onboarding. It covers Specs, design review, Tickets, TDD, implementation, code review, delivery, and post-merge cleanup. Remote repository configuration remains a separate authorized operation.
defaultPrompt: $ask-matt 评估当前工程任务并路由到合适阶段
